title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 2
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q011_progressive
elements.title: In politics, which description best fits the noun “a progressive”?
choices: Someone who refuses to take any political position
Someone who supports liberal or left-leaning social reform
Someone who wants every existing institution to remain unchanged
Someone who counts ballots on election day
elements.correctAnswer: Someone who supports liberal or left-leaning social reform
